title: Room and Harvest
author: Odile Crane
blurb: Ines Sandoval, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the harvest moon rises.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
